title: keyboard remap not work if pressed alt+f4
author: motazreda
summary: After Alt+F4 closes another app, a Chrome-specific remap fails until PowerToys Run or a UAC transition resets state.

confidence.rationale: The trigger is specific, but the stale state is not identified.
